name: sector-defense
description: Single-file HTML5 tower defense game for mobile

scripts.cap:prepare: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html icon.png privacy.html terms.html www/ && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run cap:prepare && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData build -quiet && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun simctl boot 'iPhone 18 Pro' 2>/dev/null; DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun simctl install 'iPhone 18 Pro' ios/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun simctl launch 'iPhone 18 Pro' io.github.markstyx.sectordefense
